components.name: Primary Button (outline info)
components.description: SubmitButton: large cyan outline, full width below 768px, natural width above; fills on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline-info { background: transparent; color: #0dcaf0; border: 1px solid #0dcaf0; border-radius: 0.3rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font: 400 1.25rem/1.5 system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: color .15s ease-in-out, background-color .15s ease-in-out, box-shadow .15s ease-in-out; } .ds-btn-outline-info:hover { background: #0dcaf0; color: #000; } .ds-btn-outline-info:focus-visible { outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.25rem rgba(13, 202, 240, 0.5); }

components.name: Selected Button (info)
components.description: Filled cyan marks the selected option in a set.
components.css: .ds-btn-info { background: #0dcaf0; color: #000; border: 1px solid #0dcaf0; border-radius: 0.25rem; padding: 0.375rem 0.75rem; font: 400 1rem/1.5 system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-info:hover { background: #31d2f2; border-color: #25cff2; } .ds-btn-info:focus-visible { outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.25rem rgba(11, 172, 204, 0.5); }

components.name: Category Chips
components.description: Most-used categories: small outline chips in a wrapping row, the selected one filled.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem; background: #212529; padding: 1rem; } .ds-chip { background: transparent; color: #0dcaf0; border: 1px solid #0dcaf0; border-radius: 0.2rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem; font: 400 0.875rem/1.5 system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { background: #0dcaf0; color: #000; } .ds-chip--on { background: #0dcaf0; color: #000; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.25rem rgba(13, 202, 240, 0.5); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Default Bootstrap white field on the dark page, light label above, muted help below.
components.html: Use decimal point as decimal separator.
components.css: .ds-field { background: #212529; padding: 1rem; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-field__label { display: block; color: #f8f9fa; margin-bottom: 0.25rem; } .ds-req { color: #dc3545; } .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; background: #fff; color: #212529; border: 1px solid #ced4da; border-radius: 0.25rem; padding: 0.375rem 0.75rem; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.5; transition: border-color .15s ease-in-out, box-shadow .15s ease-in-out; } .ds-input:focus { outline: 0; border-color: #86b7fe; box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.25rem rgba(13, 110, 253, 0.25); } .ds-field__help { display: block; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5); font-size: 0.875em; margin-top: 0.25rem; }

components.name: Outlined Card
components.description: Same colour as the page, separated by a cyan hairline.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #212529; color: #f8f9fa; border: 1px solid #0dcaf0; border-radius: 0.25rem; padding: 1rem; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-card__title { font-weight: 300; font-size: 1.25rem; line-height: 1.2; margin: 0 0 0.5rem; } .ds-card__text { margin: 0; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: NavBar
components.description: A row of 32px light icons spread across the width with a cyan underline.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; background: #212529; border-bottom: 1px solid #0dcaf0; padding: 0.5rem 0; } .ds-nav a { color: #f8f9fa; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; display: inline-flex; transition: color .15s ease-in-out; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0dcaf0; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Feedback: Empty and Error
components.description: EmptyState (info tint, role=status) for nothing-yet; ErrorAlert (danger, role=alert) only for failures.
components.html:
No spending recorded this month yet.

Could not reach the server.
components.css: .ds-feedback { background: #212529; padding: 1rem; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-alert { margin: 0 0 1rem; padding: 1rem; text-align: center; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.25rem; } .ds-alert--info { color: #055160; background: #cff4fc; border-color: #b6effb; } .ds-alert--danger { color: #842029; background: #f8d7da; border-color: #f5c2c7; }

components.name: Success Toast
components.description: Solid white toast below the navbar; slides in over 150ms and auto-hides.
components.css: .ds-toast { background: #fff; color: #212529; border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1); border-radius: 0.25rem; box-shadow: 0 0.5rem 1rem rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15); padding: 0.75rem; max-width: 350px; font: 400 0.875rem/1.5 system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; animation: ds-toast-in 150ms ease-out; } @keyframes ds-toast-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-8px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-toast { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
A notebook you keep on you: you open it, write the line, and close it. The page is near-black, the ink is one colour (Bootstrap's `info` cyan), and every entry is plain text with no ornament. Nothing on a screen should slow down writing the next line or reading the last one.

The system is stock Bootstrap 5.1.3 used almost entirely through utility classes, with no theme layer and no custom tokens. That restraint is part of the identity: the app looks like a well-kept tool, not a product that sells itself. Character comes from a few deliberate choices: light-weight (300) headings, cyan hairlines instead of filled surfaces, emoji on categories, and the coral wordmark glowing on the logged-out home.

Density is set for a 390px phone held in one hand. Controls are full-width, lists are long and scroll vertically, and nothing needs sideways dragging.
keyCharacteristics: Dark page, light text, one cyan accent for anything you can act on.
Flat: structure comes from 1px cyan borders, not shadows or tonal layers.
White form controls on the dark page (default Bootstrap, no overrides).
Light (300) headings; body text at the system default weight.
Emoji carry the category personality; the UI chrome stays plain.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Cyan is the only interaction colour. A new clickable thing is cyan (outline at rest, filled when selected); it is never coral, green or a new hue.

rules.name: The Red Means Broken Rule
rules.body: Danger red appears only for failures and destructive actions. "No data yet" is `EmptyState` (info tint), never an error.

rules.name: The Light Heading Rule
rules.body: Headings use weight 300 (`fw-light`). Hierarchy comes from size and space, never from bold.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Group content with a 1px `border-info` line, not with a shadow or a lighter panel.

dos: **Do** design and check every screen at 390px first.
**Do** use `SubmitButton` for every form's main action (full width and 48px tall on phones) and `btn-info` for the selected state.
**Do** keep form controls default Bootstrap white; don't theme them dark.
**Do** use `fw-light` for page and section titles.
**Do** wrap tables in `table-responsive` and mark amounts and dates `text-nowrap`.
**Do** use `EmptyState` for empty lists, `ErrorAlert` for failures and `SuccessToast` for confirmed writes.
donts: **Don't** introduce a second interaction colour. Coral is a brand mark, not a button.
**Don't** use shadows or lighter panels to separate content; use a cyan hairline.
**Don't** add custom CSS where a Bootstrap utility already does the job.
**Don't** let a value wrap mid-number or force a table to scroll sideways at 390px when stacking would work.
